info.name: Darul Ulum Management System API
info.description: End-to-end Postman collection for the Darul Ulum school management backend (API v2). Run Auth > Admin Login first. Create academic setup records before running dependent requests. Role-specific self-service requests use teacherToken, studentToken, or parentToken; set the corresponding credentials in the environment and run those login requests.

request.description: Logs in as an admin and stores the token in the collection variable token. Set identifier/password in the environment.
Logs in as a teacher and stores the token in teacherToken.
Logs in as a student and stores the token in studentToken.
Logs in as a parent and stores the token in parentToken.
Changing the password clears mustChangePassword. Use the current password and a new password of at least 8 characters.
